name: Line Item Allowance Charge 1
definition: Pricing component, such as a service, promotion, allowance or charge, for this line item.

ChargeIndicator.name: Charge Indicator
ChargeIndicator.definition: Indication of whether or not this allowance charge is a charge.

ActualAmount.name: Actual Amount
ActualAmount.definition: Actual monetary value of this allowance charge.

BasisQuantity.name: Basis Quantity
BasisQuantity.definition: Quantity on which this allowance charge is based.

CalculationPercent.name: Calculation Percent
CalculationPercent.definition: Percentage applied to calculate this allowance charge.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Specifies the order in which the allowance or charge is applied.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason, expressed as text, for this allowance charge.
